caption: Table 1. Wound classification system described by the National Research Council
rows: • Non-traumatic, non-inflamed wound with no entry into the urogenital, gastrointestinal or respiratory tracts
• Entry into the gastrointestinal, urogenital or respiratory tracts under controlled conditions without unusual contamination
• A clean surgical procedure with a minor break in aseptic technique or drain placed
• Spillage from the gastrointestinal or urogenital tracts
• Traumatic wound >4-hour old or with devitalized tissue or foreign bodies
• Acute bacterial inflammation or pus encountered
• Clean tissues transected for access to an abscess
